name: form-engine
title: Form Engine
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.pxxl.click>
description: A step orchestration engine for multi-step and single-step forms. Owns the flow — you own the fields. Bring any validation library via plugins, or wire in your own form state with FormEngineStep.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/form-engine. Use FormEngine for a batteries-included experience with config-driven fields, or FormEngineRoot for headless mode. The engine manages step flow, validation gates, and submission — you bring the fields and state. Plugins extend lifecycle hooks for validation, analytics, and more.
